figures.caption: Figure 1: Five-layer taxonomy for AI observability. Each layer addresses a distinct abstraction level, from model internals (top) to infrastructure tracing (bottom). Arrows indicate information flow. Each surveyed paper maps to its primary layer.
Table 1: Comparative analysis of surveyed approaches across six dimensions.
Table 2: Key quantitative results from each surveyed paper.

Figure 2: Information flow between observability layers. Solid arrows indicate established connections; dashed arrows indicate unexplored cross-layer integrations that represent open research opportunities.
